show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Once a legendary barrister, Anand Awasthi now roams the streets as a broken drunk, his past glory buried in shame and despair. When his former interns Rohan and Mayur stumble upon him, and a brave young woman Devika seeks his help to fight against her powerful in-laws, Anand must confront his demons. Will this fallen lawyer rise again to deliver justice?
